maximum.description: Checks for measurements above the recommended plausible range.

max.label: Maximum plausible value
max.help: Measurements above this value fail the check.

baselineDrift.name: Baseline drift
baselineDrift.description: Screens for low-end baseline changes using valid history. The indicator is normalized by the full lookback; it is not a physical slope.
baselineDrift.suggestedDescription: This screening tool is Off by default. Enable it deliberately after reviewing these settings for your sensors and operating conditions.

lookback_hours.label: Lookback hours
lookback_hours.help: Number of recent hours used to evaluate baseline drift.

min_samples.label: Minimum measurements
min_samples.help: Minimum valid historical measurements, excluding the candidate. Each half of the lookback needs at least half this count, rounded up.

baseline_quantile.label: Baseline quantile
baseline_quantile.help: Low-end quantile used to estimate the sensor baseline.

max_drift_per_day.label: Maximum baseline shift indicator (per day)
max_drift_per_day.help: Low-quantile shift divided by the full lookback in days. Preset values are screening references, not validated physical slope limits.

direction.label: Direction
direction.help: Choose whether to check upward, downward, or both directions.

unavailable.name: Unavailable QC check
unavailable.description: A configured QC check is not currently available.

flagForReview.label: Flag for review
flagForReview.description: Keep the measurement available and record a QC warning.

markInvalid.label: Mark invalid
markInvalid.description: Record the QC failure and exclude the measurement from normal downstream use.

detail.loadError: This parameter's quality control settings could not be loaded.
detail.unitDefaultsDescription: Each supported unit has its own minimum and maximum configuration.
detail.checksDescription: Each check is shown with its current value, behavior, and source.
detail.advancedHelp: Advanced aggregation settings are preserved but cannot be edited in this phase.
detail.customPolicy: Parameter overrides saved; other settings inherit CompassAQ defaults. See each check below.
detail.inheritedPolicy: Inherits CompassAQ defaults. Enabled, disabled and unavailable checks are shown below.
detail.hierarchy: CompassAQ default → parameter override → source + parameter → sensor override. More specific settings take precedence; other properties remain inherited.
detail.unitLimitations: Each unit has its own policy. Exact ppm/ppb and mg/m³/µg/m³ conversions follow policy inheritance rules. Gas mass concentrations are not converted to mixing ratios.
